title: Training for Corporate Partners in Family100 Programme
what_it_is: Training for Corporate Partners in Family100 Programme

sections.label: ComLink family outcomes and befrienders
sections.summary: ComLink aims for Stability, Self-reliance and Social Mobility, with volunteer befrienders paired with MSF Family Coaches and cases referred to professionals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The objective is to help the ComLink family achieve the three "S" outcomes of Stability, Self-reliance and Social Mobility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: These include mental health issues, substance misuse and domestic violence or abuse.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: However, the volunteer befrienders are not expected to provide intervention.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Such cases should rightfully be managed by social service or healthcare professionals to whom the families would be referred as needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: The progress of all 14,000 families with young children in rental housing, including those under the Family100 Programme, will be tracked under ComLink.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Hence, there is no need for separate evaluations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: When going out and talking to these ComLink families, what we need to remember is that the volunteer befrienders are always paired with a Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) Family Coach, who is a professional in this case.

sections.label: ComLink rollout stages
sections.summary: ComLink is at its infancy stage, with pilots started in 2019 in four towns and ramped up in 2021 across Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But bear in mind that we are now at the infancy stage of ComLink rollout.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We started the pilots in 2019 in four towns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: We ramped it up in 2021 across the whole of Singapore.
